name: Anubhav Lal
title: AI Engineer
summary: I am an AI Engineer who builds production Generative AI systems in Python, LLM agents, RAG pipelines, and the FastAPI backends behind them. At KAT Enterprise, I engineer a multi-agent platform on LangGraph where GPT-4 agents use 15+ custom tools to find and book service providers on their own, served through async REST APIs with SSE streaming and typed Pydantic contracts.

I care about making LLM applications dependable, not just impressive in a demo. That means schema-constrained outputs, business rules kept in deterministic code, human review where decisions matter, and evaluation harnesses that check grounding, citations, retrieval recall, and faithfulness before anything ships.

Before KAT, I built Django and FastAPI services at Jupitos Technologies, including a dual-agent interview bot with sub-200ms context retrieval, and began my career in cyber security at Supraja Technologies, which still shapes how I design secure APIs and AI systems.

I hold an MCA from SRM Institute of Science and Technology and a BCA from Acharya Institute of Graduate Studies, and published a peer-reviewed paper on real-time biometric attendance automation. Outside work, I enjoy football, reading, and video games.
tagline: I build AI agents that hold up in production.
